title: Beyond the clock: How 12-year-old Uno Magallanes learns to overcome failure in speedcubing
summary: At 12-years old, Juan Miguel "Uno" Magallanes has already made a name for himself in competitive speedcubing, specializing in the 2x2 Rubik's Cube and earning a national record in the event.
